name: bond-kind-unspecified-stereo-declaration
description: Adversary pass, Phase 0, attack surface 4, and a live reproduction of a second finding reported separately: adding any file under packages/validators/fixtures/ that ends .oracle.json, exactly the extension mechanism corpus.ts and CONTRACT.md document as sanctioned, currently fails all six conservation-* checks, because NON_FIXTURE_FILES in packages/validators/src/fixtures.ts lists only README.md and was never updated for the .oracle.json suffix. That failure is expected here and is not a defect in this fixture; see the adversary report for the full finding. What this file itself is for: gate-self-test.ts's synthetic negative controls for the unspecified stereo declaration mechanism are all kind: "atom"; STEREO_DECLARATION is hardcoded to kind: "atom" and no assertion in ASSERTIONS ever builds a kind: "bond" case, so the bond arm of the declaration mechanism was untested against real RDKit output before this file existed. This is 2-butene, a genuine stereogenic C2=C3 double bond left undrawn and declared an artifact with a kind: "bond" entry. Expect ADJUDICATION, never a plain pass and never a failure, the bond-kind mirror of declaredUnspecifiedStereo in gate-self-test.ts. The stand-in justification below is not a claim that 2-butene's E/Z is genuinely unpinnable chemistry, only a mechanical exercise of the bond-kind path end to end against real RDKit output. The three failure arms of the same mechanism, undeclared, stale, and a ref naming nothing, were also exercised for kind: "bond" against real RDKit and all three failed exactly as the atom-kind self test assertions predict; they are not kept here as a live fixture because the oracle corpus format has no mechanism, unlike a conservation fixture's mustFail, to declare a state expected to fail without leaving the suite permanently red, so they are reported as pure unit tests instead. See packages/validators/tests/stereo-descriptors-bond-kind.test.ts.

sequences.description: 2-butene with bond b2 (C2=C3) carrying stereo: null and a kind: "bond" declaration naming it, non empty justification. Expect ADJUDICATION.
